_comment: Part-number decoders for memory devices, based on the vendors' published part-numbering schemes. A decoder only fires on a FULL match of its pattern. Decoded values are labelled 'decoder' in reports and must be confirmed against the datasheet. Density is expressed in bits. Named groups: depth/width (density = depth Mi x width), dens (e.g. 4G = 4 Gbit), org (code looked up in org_map), mbit (megabits).

decoders.scheme: Samsung DRAM part numbering (K4 + family + density + organisation)
SK hynix DDR3 part numbering (H5T + voltage + density + organisation + banks)
SK hynix DDR4 part numbering (H5AN + density + organisation)
Micron DRAM part numbering (MT + family + depth M + width)
decoders.note: Applies to the full part number only. Micron packages are usually marked with a 5-character FBGA code instead, which must be decoded with Micron's FBGA decoder.

decoders.scheme: Nanya DRAM part numbering (NT5 + family + depth M + width)
Winbond SpiFlash naming (W25Q + density in Mbit)
Winbond SpiFlash NAND naming (W25N + density in Gbit + G)
GigaDevice GD25 naming (GD25 + series + density in Mbit)
Macronix MX25 naming (MX25 + voltage + density in Mbit + 2-digit version)

decoders.note: Capacity is user capacity class in gigabytes (GB).
